title: quadrant: client proxy OFF -> nothing to report
why: Quadrant 2 of the two-end proxy matrix (tests/cases/README.md 7.5). The negative control for the client side: with ProxyEnable=0 there is no hijack to report, so the check must be pass/proxy_ok and must not drift into degraded or unknown. Together with quadrant-proxy-client-on-no-bypass this pins both directions of the client-side judgement.
